current_stage_label: Waiting for a new flow event

stages.label: 1. Commit received
stages.detail: A push to the monitored branch starts the flow.
stages.if_case: If push is valid → continue. If no relevant change → stop.

stages.label: 2. Capture exact diff
stages.detail: Record before/after commits, changed files, author and commit message.
stages.if_case: If capture succeeds → continue. If capture errors → stop and report the workflow run.

stages.label: 3. Security scan
stages.detail: Run the security engine against the captured change.
stages.if_case: If no HIGH/CRITICAL findings → pass. If findings → send them to remediation.

stages.label: 4. AI remediation
stages.detail: Try the primary model, retry on failure, then switch to the fallback model.
stages.if_case: If fix is generated → validate. If model/API errors exhaust retries → stop as ERROR.

stages.label: 5. Sandbox validation
stages.detail: Validate AI-modified files in a disposable isolated environment.
stages.if_case: If sandbox passes → re-scan. If it fails → retry another remediation attempt.

stages.label: 6. Post-fix scan
stages.detail: Re-scan the changed repository state and compare against the original findings.
stages.if_case: If original findings are resolved and no new blocking findings appear → continue. Otherwise retry/fallback.

stages.label: 7. Remediation PR
stages.detail: Create the readable AI remediation branch and pull request.
stages.if_case: If PR creation succeeds → GitHub PR review flow starts. If GitHub API fails → ERROR with run details.

stages.label: 8. Full PR security re-scan
stages.detail: Run a full-repository security review against the PR head.
stages.if_case: If clean → pass to human review. If HIGH/CRITICAL remains → fail the PR.

stages.label: 9. Human review
stages.detail: A human reviews the AI-generated change before merge.
stages.if_case: If approved → merge. If changes requested → another PR commit triggers the flow again.

stages.label: 10. Merge / completed
stages.detail: The reviewed remediation is merged and the dashboard records the final state.
stages.if_case: If merged → completed. If closed without merge → closed.
